explanation: The sampled data has 10 times fewer negatives, so the odds the model learned are 10 times too high. Dividing the odds by 10: $p = q / (q + (1 - q)/w) = 0.5 / (0.5 + 0.5 / 0.1) = 0.5 / 5.5 \approx 0.0909$. Without the correction, an ads system would overbid by a factor of about 5 on this impression.
